business_scope.primary_industry_name: Industrial Quick-Freezing of Steamed Dim Sum and Dumplings

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (Romano-Germanic legal system; unitary national jurisdiction with separate administrative courts, commercial courts and notarial practice)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Bilateral Investment Treaty between the French Republic and the People's Republic of China on the reciprocal encouragement and protection of investments (signed 30 May 1984; in force) — protects qualifying Chinese investors with national treatment, most-favoured-nation treatment and expropriation guarantees.

Convention between the French Republic and the People's Republic of China for the avoidance of double taxation and the prevention of fiscal evasion with respect to taxes on income and on capital (signed 30 November 1984; in force, as amended) — governs taxation of dividends, interest, royalties, capital gains and permanent establishments.

Agreement on trade and economic cooperation between the European Economic Community and the People's Republic of China (1985; in force) — provides an overall cooperation framework relevant to trade in goods, commercial exchanges and investment facilitation between the EU Member States, including France, and China.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Articles L561-1 to L561-56 of the French Monetary and Financial Code (Code monétaire et financier), as amended by Law No. 2016-731 of 3 June 2016 (Sapin II) and Decree No. 2016-1636 of 1 December 2016; Article L561-45 et seq. CMF imposing the beneficial-owner declaration; French Commercial Code (Code de commerce) and INPI's Guichet unique formalities requiring the RCS registration of each SARL beneficiary owner; TRACFIN supervisory enforcement and the French implementation of Directive (EU) 2015/849 as amended by Directive (EU) 2018/843.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent company registrar in the shareholder's country of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization for states non-party to the Apostille Convention; followed by sworn French translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Memorandum and Articles of Association / Constitutional Documents of each foreign corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Shareholders' general meeting / competent corporate authority of the shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization; followed by sworn French translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Corporate resolution of the shareholder(s) approving the incorporation of the SARL and appointing the first manager(s)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of directors / shareholders' general meeting of the corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized extract plus Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization; followed by sworn French translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Passport / valid national identity document of each proposed SARL manager and each controlling beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National passport authority / civil registry of the holder's country of origin or residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized certified copy plus Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization where required by the filing jurisdiction; followed by sworn French translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Police criminal record extract / certificate of good conduct of each proposed manager from the country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Judicial authority / national criminal records office of the residence country
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization; followed by sworn French translation

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, managers, authorized signatories and bank account representatives against the UN Security Council Consolidated List, the EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, OFAC's SDN and non-SDN lists where a US nexus exists, French national asset-freezing measures administered through TRACFIN, and domestic PEP lists and public-office databases, including the Haute Autorité pour la transparence de la vie publique (HATVP) declarations; enhanced due diligence is required for any PEP, close family member or close associate, for companies incorporated in high-risk third countries, and for non-resident corporate shareholders without clear commercial substance; screening results must be documented, dated, retained for at least five years and updated at least every six months while the SARL remains in formation.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Guichet unique des formalités d'entreprises operated by the Institut National de la Propriété Industrielle (INPI) — https://formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr; the underlying company register is the Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS) maintained with the competent commercial court registry.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The corporate name (dénomination sociale) must be expressed in Latin characters compatible with the INPI/RCS indexing system. French law does not prohibit foreign-language names, but compulsory filings, articles of association, registration notifications and public notices must contain a French version or be accompanied by a sworn French translation. Names in non-Latin scripts, including Chinese ideograms, Cyrillic or Arabic, must be transliterated into a consistent Latin-alphabet version that is used uniformly in the corporate documents, RCS filing, bank account opening and customs registration documents.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: France does not operate a separate statutory pre-incorporation name reservation register. Name availability is checked during the RCS/Guichet unique filing process. If the INPI/RCS registry rejects the proposed name, the applicant may submit a written recours gracieux to the relevant INPI/RCS service within 30 days of the notification, attaching the corrected name and supporting legal arguments; if the administrative refusal is maintained, a formal appeal (recours pour excès de pouvoir) may be filed before the competent tribunal administratif within two months of the refusal notification under Articles R421-1 and R421-2 of the French Code de justice administrative. Since no reservation or extension window exists, the applicant should immediately re-file with an alternative compliant name without abandoning the incorporation. A private trademark opposition, by contrast, must be resolved through the tribunal judiciaire in a separate civil action.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual offices are not per se unlawful for a French SARL, but their use is strictly limited. The registered office may be domiciled with a licensed commercial domiciliation company or for certain cases at the manager's residence, but for an ISIC 1074 frozen dim sum and dumpling production factory the company must also maintain and declare a physical industrial plant address. The industrial address alone will carry the SIRET establishment registration, DGCCRF/DDPP food safety registration, customs EORI registration, payroll administration and commercial substance; a purely virtual office cannot satisfy the French food-hygiene, public-health, labour-inspection or tax substance requirements.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Very high; quantified at approximately 90% probability of an unannounced on-site inspection by the DDPP (Direction départementale de la protection des populations), DGCCRF, labour inspectorate or customs authorities within the first 12 months of production. For food-processing plants producing quick-frozen finished products under Regulation (EC) No 178/2002 and French Code de la consommation health rules, an initial inspection is nearly mandatory before the commencement of full industrial operations, and unannounced sanitation/refrigeration inspections are routine thereafter.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: French Commercial Code (Code de commerce), Articles L.223-1 to L.223-43 for the SARL; Article L.223-2 on share capital; Article L.223-7 on payment of cash contributions; Articles R.123-31 to R.123-37 on registration with the Register of Commerce and Companies (RCS); and Décret no. 2019-1669 governing electronic filing through the Guichet Unique.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (Commercial Court Registry) of the territorial jurisdiction of the registered office, receiving filings through the INPI Guichet Unique des formalités d'entreprises.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for registration at the RCS (Form P0 M-B) filed through formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr, with the signed articles of association (statuts) and supporting annexes annexed.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: There is no statutory minimum capital for a French SARL; the capital is freely fixed in the articles. Cash contributions must be deposited on a blocked account with a licensed bank or Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations, and at least 20% of the subscribed cash value must be paid up at incorporation, with the balance payable within five years. The bank blocking certificate is submitted with the incorporation file and released upon RCS registration.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: The shareholders unanimously resolve: (1) the issued share capital of €[X], divided into [Y] shares at a nominal value of €[Z], as stated in the articles of association, is fully subscribed and allotted to the subscribers. (2) The registered office is fixed at [address], and the registered-office lease or domiciliation agreement is adopted and approved. (3) [Name], being eligible, is appointed gérant for an indefinite term, with all powers to act in the corporate interest under the French Commercial Code. (4) The gérant is instructed to complete all publication, registration, and licensing formalities and to record this resolution in the corporate books.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting, approval and signing of the articles of association (Statuts) and governance instruments
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: All founding partners; a French legal adviser or notaire may be engaged, and a notaire is required if real property or other assets subject to formal valuation are contributed.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the French-language statuts containing the legal form, corporate name, registered office, object clause, share capital, duration, and management rules. The object clause must expressly cover the industrial preparation, quick-freezing, packing, and distribution of dim sums, dumplings, and related convenience food products. Have each partner initial every page and sign the final page. If contributions are made exclusively in cash, a private deed may be used; if an in-kind contribution is made, obtain a notarial deed and a contribution auditor's report where required. Attach the list of subscribers and share allocations.
required_dossiers: Draft final statuts
Identity documents of all founding partners and the appointed gérant
Proposed lease or registered-office domiciliation agreement
Contribution auditor's report or notarial deed if contribution in kind
Declaration of eligibility and absence of judicial incapacities of the gérant
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry queries the object clause, signature validity, or capital allocation, amend the statuts and re-execute the signatures, using a notarial correction deed if required, then resubmit the rectified document through the same electronic filing portal.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Opening of blocked capital deposit account and obtaining the capital funds certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: A bank licensed in France or the Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations (CDC).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporarily blocked account in the name of the company being formed and have each subscriber transfer the subscribed cash amount. The bank issues an attestation de blocage des fonds certifying the deposit. Ensure that at least 20% of the cash subscription is released at incorporation and that any remaining amount is left available for subsequent contribution calls by the gérant. Funds may not be unblocked until the company is registered in the RCS and the certificate is remitted to the registry.
required_dossiers: Copy of the signed or project articles of association
Identity documents of each cash subscriber
Bank Know-Your-Customer and anti-money-laundering documents
Corporate authorization evidence if a shareholder is a legal entity
Payment instructions and transfer records for the capital funds
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank refuses the account opening or delays issuance of the blocking certificate, select another licensed bank or the CDC, and obtain a replacement certificate; the incorporation file must be accompanied by a valid certificate issued in the company's name.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publication of legal formation announcement in an authorized Journal d'annonces légales (JAL)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: An authorized legal announcements newspaper in the department of the registered office, selected by the subscribers through an online legal announcement service.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a French-language legal notice containing the proposed corporate name, legal form, share capital, registered office, corporate purpose, term, and the identity of the gérant. Pay the publication fee and obtain the publisher's receipt with the date and issue number. The published notice must exactly match the final statuts and the later RCS filing.
required_dossiers: Completed legal announcement order form
Final wording of the corporate object and capital clauses
Identity details of the appointed gérant
Registered-office address and identification of the court of registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the newspaper requests alterations to comply with local publication practice, amend the notice wording and republish, then obtain a conformity receipt to avoid any discrepancy between the published announcement and the filed statuts.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing incorporation file with the INPI Guichet Unique and registration at the RCS
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INPI Guichet Unique Entreprendre at formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr, with transmission to the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce and INSEE.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete and submit Form P0 M-B electronically. Attach the signed statuts, bank capital blocking certificate, legal announcement receipt, proof of registered office, identity documents, and the gérant declaration. Pay the greffe registration fees through the platform. After completeness verification, the file is transmitted to the commercial registry and INSEE. Upon approval, the prepaid account is opened, the company is enrolled in the RCS, and the Kbis extract is issued.
required_dossiers: Form P0 M-B
Signed statutory articles
Bank capital blocking certificate
Proof of publication of the legal announcement
Lease or domiciliation agreement for the registered office
Identity documents and declaration on honour of the gérant
Power of attorney if filed by an agent
Beneficial ownership declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry issues a query or rejection, make corrections through the Guichet Unique portal within the stated deadline, generally 15 days, attach the missing notarized or attested documents, and resubmit; the administrative procedure does not require restarting the incorporation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-registration formalities: BODACC publication and tax and social data collection
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce, INSEE, and the professional online company account of the legal representative.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Verify that the Kbis extract contains the exact corporate name, registered office, object clause, share capital, and gérant details. The registry publishes the registration entry in the BODACC official bulletin. The legal representative then obtains the SIREN, SIRET establishment number, and VAT identification from INSEE, opens or activates the professional bank account, and files the beneficial ownership declaration with the competent authorities.
required_dossiers: Kbis extract
SIREN and SIRET assignment notice
BODACC publication certificate
VAT identification confirmation
Professional bank account opening evidence
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If SIREN or VAT details are delayed, contact INSEE through the official professional portal and file the statutory declaration using the provisional SIREN as evidence for licensing applications; correct any erroneous Kbis information by filing a rectification request with the registry.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of industrial, environmental and occupational safety licensing dossiers
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Préfecture of the department for ICPE permitting, DREAL for technical environmental instructions, DDPP for food safety and hygiene, and SDIS for fire safety inspections.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Before commissioning the quick-freezing factory, file the ICPE enregistrement or déclaration dossier together with the agrément sanitaire application if animal-origin ingredients are used. Provide the environmental self-monitoring plan, cooling refrigerant inventory, wastewater pre-treatment arrangements, fire safety design, and structural calculations for freezer loads. Coordinate with the civil defense authority and labor inspectorate to obtain the operating clearances needed before production starts.
required_dossiers: ICPE registration or declaration form
Environmental impact or non-technical questionnaire
Food business operator registration and, if applicable, EU sanitary approval request
Wastewater discharge authorization application
Fire safety certificate or technical inspection report
Structural load certificate for freezing, storage, and production lines
HACCP plan and potable water compliance record
Occupational health risk assessment and prevention measures
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the environmental inquiry requires modification, amend the dossier and provide supplementary studies; if the requested changes are substantial, obtain a revised administrative order after additional investigation and stakeholder consultation.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Direction Régionale de l'Environnement, de l'Aménagement et du Logement (DREAL) for environmental matters, the departmental Préfecture for ICPE permitting, and the Direction Départementale de la Protection des Populations (DDPP) for food safety, hygiene, and occupational controls in the agro-food sector.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: ICPE Enregistrement as an Installation Classée pour la Protection de l'Environnement under Articles L.511-1 et seq. of the French Environmental Code, covering ICPE rubriques 2220/2221 for food-product preparation and cold storage, together with, where applicable, EU sanitary approval and agrément under Regulation (EC) No 853/2004 for products of animal origin.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: DREAL (Direction Régionale de l'Environnement, de l'Aménagement et du Logement) of the region where the factory is located.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category B: ICPE registration (enregistrement). If production or storage capacity exceeds the thresholds of the authorization regime under Article L.512-1, a full environmental impact assessment and public inquiry will be required.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with the French Water Law and the local sewerage arrêté; food-processing wastewater must meet applicable discharge limits or receive on-site pre-treatment before entering municipal sewers. Refrigerants are managed under EU F-Gas Regulation No 517/2014, and emissions, odors, and waste handling follow the European Commission's Best Available Techniques reference document for the food, drink, and milk industries.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification from the local fire and rescue service (SDIS) covering emergency exits, fire compartments, extinguishing systems, and evacuation routes; structural load inspection for the building and freezer storage racks; electrical and gas installation conformity certificates; and occupational health clearance under the French Labour Code covering noise, cold stress, food allergens, and worker exposure prevention.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP), Ministry of Economy and Finance; official portal: impots.gouv.fr; business creation and formalities portal: formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-owned SARL is formed electronically through the Guichet Unique (single business formalities portal) at formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr. The registration generates the SIREN/SIRET identifier, and the DGFiP assigns the French intra-Community VAT number (FR plus 11-digit SIREN) after validation of the VAT-status declaration through the same portal; the number is then activated in VIES for intra-EU transactions. For export operations, the SARL must additionally obtain an EORI number via the customs administration. Non-resident shareholders require no prior authorization and there is no minimum paid-in capital for a SARL.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Under CGI Article 239A, a family SARL whose shares are held exclusively by natural persons connected by marriage, direct lineage or sibling relationship may elect to be fiscally transparent and taxed in the partners' hands by filing the relevant declaration with the service des impôts des entreprises. All other SARLs are mandatorily taxed at entity level to French corporate income tax. A French parent holding at least 95% of the SARL may elect group consolidation (intégration fiscale) under CGI Article 223A. France does not operate a US-style check-the-box election; hybrid-mismatch outcomes are neutralized mandatorily under the ATAD rules.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (Taxe sur la Valeur Ajoutée - TVA)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Under CGI Article 293B, the annual VAT small-business exemption threshold is €85,000 of turnover for supplies of goods (including industrialized frozen-food production) and €37,500 for services; once the applicable threshold is exceeded, the SARL must file a VAT registration application. An exporting manufacturer is nevertheless normally registered from inception in order to recover input VAT on plant, machinery and operating purchases.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: France is implementing a phased mandatory structured e-invoicing regime for all established VAT-payable persons. For domestic B2B transactions, e-invoices in Factur-X or UBL format must be issued through certified dematerialization platforms and/or the Public Invoicing Portal (Portail Public de Facturation), with full invoice-data transmission to DGFiP; the obligation is phased from 1 September 2026 for large businesses and 1 September 2027 for SMEs. Cross-border transactions must be reported through e-reporting (transaction-level data sent to DGFiP) using the same public/API interface. The system is not an Italian-style continuous fiscal-clearance stamping model, but it gives the administration near-real-time access to invoice flows and automated VAT-control scoring.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods sold by the SARL and transported outside the European Union by or on behalf of the seller are within the VAT export exemption (exonération à l'exportation) and are effectively zero-rated with full deduction of input VAT. To qualify, the SARL must prove that the goods physically left EU territory, that the export customs declaration has been accepted, and that the outward transportation and commercial documentation are consistent with the declared non-EU destination. Services directly linked to exported goods and services supplied to a non-EU recipient outside France are also outside French VAT under place-of-supply rules. The supporting evidence must be retained for audit review, ordinarily for six years.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (SAD/DAU lodged electronically in the DELTA export control system)
Export Movement Certificate or customs exit confirmation evidencing physical departure from the EU
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing transportation to a non-EU destination
Commercial invoice and packing list matching the export customs declaration
Inward Remittance Certificate (bank SWIFT MT103 or other bank statement) showing export proceeds receipt and repatriation
Delivery terms and proof of transfer of ownership or risk to the foreign buyer
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: If DGFiP establishes during audit that the export evidence is false, incomplete or internally inconsistent, the export exemption is nullified and the SARL is reassessed at 20% VAT on the sale price, with late-payment interest under CGI Article 1727. The administration may also claw back input VAT deducted on the underlying export purchases. Where the failure is characterized as bad faith (manquement délibéré) or fraudulent concealment, an additional penalty of 40% to 80% under CGI Article 1729 applies; criminal exposure for intentional tax evasion may reach a fine of up to €75,000 and imprisonment of up to five years under Article 1741, with further publication measures in cases of aggravated or organized fraud.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque de France (BdF, the French central bank; member of the Eurosystem/ESCB). Banking prudential supervision is delegated to the ACPR (Autorité de Contrôle Prudentiel et de Résolution), while capital-account approval and foreign-investment screening (IEF) are administered by the French Treasury, Direction Générale du Trésor (DG Trésor), under Articles L.151-1 et seq. and R.151-1 et seq. of the French Monetary and Financial Code (Code Monétaire et Financier, CMF).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Full convertibility. The EUR is the currency; France has abolished all exchange-control approval requirements since 1 January 1990. Both current-account and capital-account transactions are freely convertible pursuant to EU free-movement-of-capital rules (TFEU Articles 63-66), with no French statutory prior-approval requirement for inbound share-capital subscription, trade settlements, or profit remittance. Remaining controls: (i) balance-of-payments statistical declarations to Banque de France for any cross-border settlements aggregating above EUR 12,500 per calendar month (CMF Arts. R.152-1 to R.152-4), intermediated automatically by the collecting/remitting bank; (ii) cash-control declaration for physical movement of EUR 10,000 or more (EU Reg. 1889/2005); and (iii) DG Trésor prior-authorization screening for foreign direct investments in statutorily designated strategic sectors (Art. R.151-3 CMF). Industrial quick-freezing of dim sum and dumplings (ISIC 1074, NAICS 311412) is not a listed strategic sector, hence no IEF approval is required. Profit remittance: dividends may be freely paid to non-resident shareholders after the shareholders general meeting approves distribution, subject to the 30% French flat-tax dividend withholding (prélèvement forfaitaire unique) unless reduced by a tax treaty (e.g., France-China DTA: 10% on dividends for a qualifying corporate shareholder holding at least 25% of the capital).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No surrender obligation and no mandatory conversion ratio. Export proceeds may be retained in EUR or in freely held foreign-currency accounts opened with an ACPR-licensed French bank; there is no statutory timeline for repatriation or conversion. Operational compliance steps: (i) each export customs declaration (SAD/DAU) remains the operative document; (ii) the exporting company must provide the payment purpose or nature code to its bank on each incoming SWIFT transfer; (iii) the bank aggregates all receipts and automatically files the monthly Banque de France balance-of-payments declaration when the EUR 12,500 threshold is met; (iv) foreign-currency account balances are subject to no amount restrictions.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account (compte bloqué) + Operational Account (compte courant)
Capital Escrow Account + Operational Account + Trade Finance (UCP600 LC / URDG guarantees)

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Groupe BPCE - Natixis (Banque Populaire / Caisse d'Épargne)

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account + Asia-corridor LC and Supply Chain Finance

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Rating: MEDIUM (complementary side rail only). ACPR-licensed FinTech/EMI players - including Qonto (licensed as an établissement de crédit), Shine (a Société Générale subsidiary), N26 and Revolut (EU passporting under EEA freedom-of-services) - accept SARL accounts with fast remote onboarding and SEPA/SWIFT disbursement. Legal constraints: (i) EMIs may not issue UCP600 documentary credits or act as confirming banks; (ii) most do not intermediate the Banque de France balance-of-payments declarations automatically in the same manner as tier-1 banks; (iii) the French beneficial-ownership transparency requirement (register of beneficial owners, CMF Art. L561-2-2) applies with equal force; and (iv) standing credit and FX derivative lines are generally unavailable. They are viable for payroll, sub-account waterfall disbursements, and intercompany sweeps, but not for the principal import-LC or capital escrow structure.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote onboarding is legally permitted for low-risk SARL accounts under ACPR digital-identification guidance (video-KYC allowed under CMF Art. L561-5-1 and Decree 2018-284). In practice, tier-1 French banks impose a hybrid protocol for a foreign-owned newly-created SARL: the effective gérant must undergo either (a) a physical meeting at the commercial-bank branch, or (b) an HD video interview with a bank compliance officer, supplemented by a notarized or certified passport and an apostilled Power of Attorney if the manager does not appear. Standard checkpoint bundle: proof of address issued within the last 3 months, certified Kbis extract after legal registration, articles of association (statuts), register of beneficial owners (RBE) filing receipt, and a sworn statement on the source and traceability of the future capital inflow.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident (Asia-based) ultimate beneficial owner with no French credit profile appearing in a low-minimum-capital SARL
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified passport page and residence proof issued within 3 months; signed UBO declaration confirming thresholds under CMF Art. L561-2-2; comprehensive business plan incl. five-year cash-flow and funding traceability (source of funds matching the capital); bank reference letter from the shareholder home-correspondent bank; supplier and off-taker contracts evidencing genuine commercial activity; source-of-wealth statement for the injected funds.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Trade-based money-laundering red flags in recurrent high-frequency, small-unit-value frozen-dumpling imports/exports (e.g., unit price inconsistent with cargo manifests, or SAD/DAU customs value deviations)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Shipment-level transaction file containing commercial invoice, packing list, B/L or CMR, SAD/DAU customs declaration, certificate of origin / EUR.1 where claimed; third-party food-safety and laboratory inspection certificates; complete purchase-order chain; and commodity benchmark price indices for wheat flour, meat proteins and dumpling-specific inputs to evidence arm's-length valuation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Counterparty exposure to high-risk or sanctions-proximate jurisdictions (e.g., payments routed through Hong Kong or third-country intermediaries for Chinese ingredient suppliers, or any Russian/CIS presence in the distribution corridor)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: EU/UN/OFSI/OFAC sanctions screening reports for every counterparty (World-Check style); corporate registry extracts for each supplier; end-user and end-use contractual declarations with re-export restrictions; customs transit dossier (NCTS) demonstrating EU import/export licence compliance; group-level written confirmation of no sanctions nexus.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Escrow-type or capital-introduction structuring in the initial payment narrative triggering capital-laundering suspicion (fourth-country funding chain into the capital account)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Direct upstream shareholder-to-SARL SWIFT routing with explicit purpose code 'Inbound direct investment - share capital subscription'; shareholders meeting minutes evidencing the capital call; notarial attestation de dépôt des fonds / blocked-account certificate; 90-day bank statements proving that the funds remained unencumbered in the shareholder bank prior to transfer.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant sequence: (1) Open a blocked share-capital deposit account (compte bloqué) with BNP Paribas or Société Générale upon signature of the statuts; (2) The shareholder wires the subscribed capital via SWIFT MT103 (non-EU) or SEPA CT (EU) using remittance reference 'capital subscription / apport en numéraire'; (3) Attach the signed articles of association, the notary or bank attestation de dépôt des fonds, the RBE filing and, after registration, the Kbis extract; (4) For non-EU funding, the receiving bank applies the standard BOP purpose code 'Direct investment - participation' and files the Banque de France statistical declaration automatically for any amount above EUR 12,500 per month - no manual authorization is required; (5) Confirm non-strategic-sector status (Art. R.151-3 CMF) if funding exceeds EUR 1 million, documenting that the frozen-food factory is not on the IEF prior-approval list; (6) Once registered, convert the blocked account into a free funds-drawing operational account.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Primary clearing rail: SWIFT MT103 (TT/Wire) for recurring ingredient, packaging, logistics and equipment payments, each tagged with the applicable EU balance-of-payments trade code and backed by invoice plus customs declaration for the bank automatic daily BOP reporting. Secondary rail: commercial letters of credit conforming with UCP600 (SWIFT MT700 issued by BNP Paribas or Société Générale) for material procurement from Asian counterparties, with reimbursement in EUR or USD via MT740/MT754 and worksite demand guarantees under URDG 758 where advance payments are called. To cap LC costs for low-value repetitive lines, use 'TT against scanned documents' (B/L, packing list, SAD) with novation protection clauses. All outbound transfers intermediated by the tier-1 bank are automatically aggregated and declared to Banque de France by the bank as collecting intermediary.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: EUR/USD deliverable outright forwards (max 24-month tenor) under ISDA 2002 / French-law CSA opened with an ACPR-licensed credit institution
EUR/CNH deliverable forwards for offshore renminbi procurement flows on dim-sum ingredient imports
EUR/CNY non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) where counterparty access to onshore RMB is unavailable
EUR/USD and EUR/CNY cross-currency interest-rate and principal swaps for capex or long-term supplier financing
EUR/USD FX swaps (swap de change) for interim liquidity and rollover of short-term commercial exposures

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual accounts filing (dépôt des comptes annuels) with RCS, including balance sheet, profit-and-loss statement, annexes and gérant's report
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de commerce (Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés, RCS)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within one month after the Ordinary General Meeting approving the annual accounts, and in any event by no later than six months after the fiscal year-end, e.g. by 31 July for a 31 December year-end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing triggers an additional €144 plus a €25 per attached page charge; after a 30-day formal notice, the registrar may ask the President of the Commercial Court to order coercive fines up to €1,500 per month; persistent failure can lead to judicial dissolution and personal liability for the gérant

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial owner confirmation/RBE update (déclaration des bénéficiaires effectifs)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS) via the annual accounts filing portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days after any share transfer or change in beneficial ownership; in the absence of change, confirmed annually with the deposit of annual accounts
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-disclosure is punishable by a fine of up to €15,000 and six months' imprisonment for legal entities and €3,750 for natural person directors; the RCS filing may be rejected until the declaration is completed

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual RCS registration confirmation and annual commercial-register fee (contribution annuelle au droit de greffe)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on the registration anniversary; invoice issued by the greffe, payable within 1 month
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Unpaid annual registration fees after two notices may trigger proceedings for administrative radiation (strike-off) of the SARL from the RCS; late payment incurs interest at the statutory rate

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return (liasse fiscale IS, forms 2065 and 2065-SD)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Direction générale des Finances publiques (DGFiP) - Service des impôts des entreprises (SIE)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For a fiscal year ending on 31 December, due by 15 May of the following year in the electronic filing calendar; other fiscal year-ends are due within 3 months after the fiscal year-end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing: 5% monthly penalty capped at 10%, plus interest of 0.40% per month; failure to file may lead to estimate-based assessment and additional €250-€1,500 penalties for failure to provide supporting documents

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: At least two of the following three thresholds: balance-sheet total exceeding €4,000,000; net turnover excluding taxes exceeding €8,000,000; average permanent employees exceeding 50. If thresholds exceeded for two consecutive years, a statutory auditor (commissaire aux comptes) must be appointed for a SARL; auditor reappointed for 6-year terms.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: French GAAP (Plan Comptable Général) in accordance with the ANC regulation n° 2016-03; IFRS not required for individual statutory accounts of a SARL unless voluntarily consolidated in a group's financial statements.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: At every annual accounts approval, an updated list of beneficial owners must be certified by the gérant and retained on file. The RBE declaration to the RCS must be updated within 30 days of any share transfer or change of control; filing must include the new distribution, stock transfer minutes, and register excerpt; if no changes, the existing RBE entry is deemed confirmed by the filing of annual accounts.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (registre des mouvements de titres)
Register of Directors (délibérations et décisions de la gérance, where applicable)
Minute Book (procès-verbaux d'assemblées générales and feuilles de présence)

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 25% (standard rate for 2024; reduced rate of 15% applies up to €42,500 of taxable profit for enterprises with turnover below €10 million)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No general tax holiday; research tax credit (CIR) at 30% up to €100 million; IP box at 10% under patent regime; rapid depreciation for energy-efficient equipment; local employment subsidies may apply
